newsitem.title: USA: Mesa to pay $270 million for WMC's Greenhill.
newsitem.headline: Mesa to pay $270 million for WMC's Greenhill.

text.p: Mesa Inc. said Monday it agreed to acquire Greenhill Petroleum Corp. from WMC Ltd. for $270 million.
Greenhill has four main oil producing areas with 522 producing wells, and over 200 development projects.
"Based on our development plans, we expect cash flow from the GPC properties of more than $65 million in 1998," Mesa said.

"Mesa has already identified 45 development wells and 132 completions. We intend to initiate 22 of these projects in 1997 and at least 25 in 1998, and plan to invest at least $65 million over the next two years."
Based on current price levels and development plans, Mesa said it expects its cash reserves to increase to more than $300 million in 1997 from about $200 million last year.
Mesa, based in Irving, Texas, said it expects to close the deal in April.
Mesa' stock edged up 12.5 cents to $5.125 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning. WMC fell 50 cents to $24.125, also on the NYSE.
